title: 踏板临界 · 路侧视觉公测 C03 R1
author: Original artwork and synthesis created for this project under the user’s direction
source: Original project car, PBR environment, near-tree, distant-tree and meadow artwork. Independent public visual test; no third-party art.
license: Project-original. No third-party art or sound samples. Redistribution is governed by the project owner.
verification: Build and targeted CPU/Node checks only. Real browser visuals, failure-state navigation, motion, touch and GPU performance remain unverified.

heroCar.status: car-only: no occupants, cracks, authored crumple states or physical suspension

runtimeAssetLoading: Same-origin mandatory c04 GLB, seven original environment files, four original roadside GLBs and three original meadow maps. No remote CDN, accounts, analytics or save transmission.

environment.scope: PBR road/shoulder and outdoor HDR for IBL; no GLB changes, no new physical collision authority.

roadside.qualityPolicy: Four fixed R1 cutout near trees only at high quality. Twenty-four opaque far trees remain at both settings, full crown at least 90m from whole route. No distance-based LOD switch.
roadside.verification: CPU load/geometry/clearance and build only. Browser pixels, visibility, alpha edge flicker, frame time and mobile behavior pending.

persistence.isolation: Independent from c02. No reads, migration, deletion or overwrite of c02 or old game storage; schema and algorithm unchanged.

uiCorrection: Failed scene load dismisses the start/tutorial overlay. Settings can remain open; returning from settings or Home preserves the readable failed state. Existing camera labels and HUD readiness gate retained. Browser pixel recheck pending.
saveIsolation: Independent C03 namespace. Does not read, migrate, delete or write original-game or c01/c02 saves.
